title: Solvothermal synthesis of carbon nitride (g-C3N4): bandgap engineering for improved photocatalytic performance
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1109-1119
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01646G, Paper
Mohammed Tajudeen Abdullahi, Maryum Ali, Wasif Farooq, Majad Khan, Muhammad Younas, Muhammad Nawaz Tahir
This study investigates the solvothermal synthesis of carbon nitride, aimed at enhancing its energy bandgap and improving its photoredox applications.
